name: No Drop Hotbar
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: ATOMIIX
description: Stops you from dropping items by accident while playing. The drop key does nothing in game, but still works normally in your inventory and chests. Client-side, with a simple settings menu (F9).
evidence: Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-25 (8dfda948) (23 classes, 34 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
